title: Cumulative-Goodness Free-Riding in Forward-Forward Networks: Real, Repairable, but Not Accuracy-Dominant
abstract: arXiv:2605.06240v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Forward-Forward (FF) training lets each layer learn from a local goodness criterion. In cumulative-goodness variants, later layers can inherit a task that earlier layers have partly separated. We formalize this as layer free-riding: under the softplus FF criterion, the class-discrimination gradient reaching block $d$ decays exponentially with the positive margin accumulated by earlier blocks (Theorem 3.1); a squared-hinge barrier reproduces the pathology. History-free and hardness-gated repairs raise deeper-layer separation by up to $5\times$ on CIFAR-100 and $45\times$ in an 8-block CIFAR-10 model, yet these and a depth-scaled auxiliary term move accuracy by under one percentage point among non-degenerate variants; on Tiny ImageNet, a harder cross-dataset check of the selected configuration, layer health likewise does not track accuracy. A theory-derived attenuation-compensated objective raises deepest-block separation $5.9\ti

translated_title: 前向-前向网络中的累积优度“搭便车”现象：真实存在、可修复，但并不主导准确率
translated_abstract: 前向-前向（Forward-Forward, FF）训练使每一层能够基于局部的优度准则进行学习。在累积优度变体中，后面的层可以继承前面各层已部分完成的类别分离任务。我们将这一现象形式化为“层间搭便车”：在softplus FF准则下，到达第d个模块的类别判别梯度会随着前面模块累积的正裕度呈指数衰减（定理3.1）；平方铰链障碍同样会复现这一病理现象。无历史记录和难度门控的修复方法在CIFAR-100上将深层分离度提升高达5倍，在8模块的CIFAR-10模型中提升45倍，然而这些方法以及深度缩放的辅助项在非退化变体中对准确率的改变不足一个百分点；在Tiny ImageNet上——作为对所选配置的更具挑战性的跨数据集检验——层的健康状况同样无法反映准确率。一个由理论推导出的衰减补偿目标函数将最深模块的分离度提升5.9倍……
tldr: 本文首次形式化了前向-前向网络中的“层间搭便车”现象（即判别梯度随前面层累积裕度呈指数衰减），提出了理论导出的修复方法使深层分离度提升高达45倍，但发现层的健康状况与最终分类准确率并不相关。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes "layer free-riding" in Forward-Forward networks—where the class-discrimination gradient reaching deeper blocks decays exponentially with the margin accumulated by earlier blocks—and shows that theory-derived repairs can boost deep-layer separation by up to 45×, yet layer health does not track final accuracy.
